rituals.title: MOVE THE RULE BETWEEN WORLDS
rituals.name: MOVE THE RULE BETWEEN WORLDS
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Evidence distortion & selective thinking

PATTERN
Context neglect

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
MISSION
A rule must survive context before it earns the word universal.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. State Rule — Picture the rule without naming who taught it. Let your eyes take in the space around you during state rule.
2. Change Context — Place it in three contrasting settings—for example family, workplace, and friendship—with different power and consequences.
3. Compare Effects — Compare who is protected, restricted, or harmed in each setting. Try one other explanation during compare effects.
4. Keep Core — Keep only the part that remains ethical and workable across contexts; Notice the rest as conditional.
⚡ FINISH — Keep Core.

rituals.name: DO ONE GOOD THING WITH NO APPLAUSE BUTTON
rituals.ritual_name: DO ONE GOOD THING WITH NO APPLAUSE BUTTON
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Uncertainty & reassurance seeking

PATTERN
Reassurance dependence

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
MISSION
Values can survive the absence of approval.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Choose Safe — do a low-risk act you endorse and do it without announcing, checking reactions, or fishing for reassurance. Take one normal breath while you do this during choose safe.
2. Let Discomfort — Let the discomfort of no feedback rise and change. Allow one different possibility to exist during let discomfort.
3. Review — Review the action by your values once it is done.
⚡ FINISH — Review.
